parts.pin_layout: Transparent top view, as Figure 6-1: left edge top to bottom 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6; right edge bottom to top 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12. EP is the large central underside thermal pad; pin-1 index is at the upper-left in this orientation.

parts.notes: Pin functions and EP instruction: p3. Absolute limits: p4; operating input and quiescent current: p5. No absolute power or load-current rating is given for this controller. Quiescent current is not a minimum operating-current specification. RTN voltage maximum (0.3 V) must not be confused with the adjacent input-pin 70 V maximum. EP is identified as pad 13 in package outline p43; keyed EP here as requested. Package outline p43 has a generic instruction to solder the thermal pad to the PCB; electrical pin table p3 specifically forbids connecting it to the GND plane. Device comparison p3 includes LM74801-Q1 with different reverse-current-blocking behavior but the same pin table.

parts.pin_layout: UNKNOWN whether the 3362P-specific p1 projection is labelled top or bottom: no view-direction label is printed. In that projection pin 1 is left and pin 3 right on the same row; pin 2 is centred and offset toward the lower edge. Use the 3362P drawing, which has a triangular lead pattern, not the inline 3362U/M patterns.
parts.polarity: Resistive terminals are not polarized. Pin 1 is the CCW end, pin 3 the CW end, and pin 2 the wiper.
parts.variants_warning: 3362W explicitly reverses the pin marking. Many other terminal styles are included; do not substitute 3362F/H/R/U/M/S/W/X/Z mechanical layouts for 3362P.
parts.notes: The p1 electrical schematic labels 1=CCW, 2=WIPER, 3=CW, with CLOCKWISE arrow toward terminal 3. Therefore clockwise rotation raises resistance between pin 1 and the wiper. 103=10,000 Ohms and LF=100% tin-plated termination are confirmed on p2. A maximum current is not specified; none is calculated from power and resistance. The common mechanical view labels 3.84 mm from the body bottom to the lead tip in the drawing; view-direction ambiguity is retained. No knob T suffix is present in the requested part.

parts.pin_layout: Top plan view on p1, actuator projecting toward the top of the drawing and signal leads along the bottom: pin 3 left, pin 2 next, pin 1 right. Four corner shell mounting tabs all carry the same circled 4 identifier. Signal-lead centres are spaced 1.5 mm (3 to 2), then 3 mm (2 to 1).
parts.polarity: No electrical polarity. Terminals 1 and 3 are throws; 2 is common; 4 labels the shell tabs (drawn with a ground symbol, separate from the signal contacts).
parts.notes: P1 circuit drawing shows terminal 2 as common and shell tabs as 4. Slider-left COM-to-throw mapping: UNKNOWN. Slider-right COM-to-throw mapping: UNKNOWN. The circuit graphic does not explicitly associate each slider position with terminal numbers; no family pinout is imported. Four physical mounting tabs are all marked 4 (not individually 4/5/6/7). P4 of the PDF (printed page 2/5) generically describes a tactile switch with 1 pole, 1 throw, inconsistent with the three-terminal slide-switch assembly drawing; p1 is used for contact topology. P3 of the PDF supplies storage range; electrical operating values agree between p1 and p4. Dielectric withstand is not a working-voltage rating.

parts.notes: Q136 row on p2 is the source for all four voltage options and current/temperature ratings. Tf=136 °C is distinct from oil-bath fusing temperature 131 ±2 °C; Th and Tm are not an operating-temperature range (definitions p8).
